title: 'Madan Dilawar, you have 48 hrs’: CJP seeks Rajasthan edu minister’s resignation
content: CJP volunteers faced an alleged attack during a school inspection in Jaipur district.  The group issued a 48-hour ultimatum to the Rajasthan government for arrests.  They demanded the resignation of education minister Madan Dilawar following the confrontation.  Local residents offered a different account, denying any assault on the visitors.  The incident occurred amid controversy over restrictions on school access.

title: Prajwal Revanna rape case: Key witness reports threat calls after testimony
content: A key witness in the Prajwal Revanna rape trial reported receiving threatening phone calls. She expressed fear for her safety and her son's well-being to the court. The special court has ordered an inquiry into the alleged threats and directed police protection. Officials recently recovered electronic devices from Prajwal Revanna's prison cell. A separate investigation is underway regarding these recovered items.

title: Treesa-Gayatri end India’s 15-year wait, assure Badminton World Championships medal
content: Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand secured a World Championships medal.  They achieved this after a comeback victory in the women's doubles quarterfinals.  This guarantees the unseeded Indian pair at least a bronze medal.  Their achievement marks the country's first medal in this event since 2011.  The pair has shown strong progress and resilience throughout their career.

title: Dowry case against 11 after woman, son killed in Haryana
content: In a heartbreaking turn of events, a young woman and her infant were allegedly killed by her in-laws after they demanded a luxury SUV as dowry, subjecting her to escalating violence. Following a fierce disagreement, she returned to her marital home bearing gifts, only to suffer further abuse. The authorities are actively investigating the tragic deaths, with her husband in custody for further inquiries.

title: Zuckerberg buys Gothic castle in Ireland, Meta's international HQ, for $35 mn
content: Meta CEO, Mark Zuckerberg, and his wife, Priscilla Chan, have acquired the historic Strancally Castle, a stunning Gothic mansion set on an expansive estate in Ireland. This remarkable property will serve as their home base during visits to the nation, which is significant due to Meta's international headquarters being located there. The couple is excited about the opportunity to preserve and nurture this piece of history.

title: Watch: CJP volunteers attempting to inspect Rajasthan govt school attacked
content: Cockroach Janta Party volunteers faced alleged assault by BJP workers during a school inspection. CJP co-convenor Ashutosh Ranka reported injuries and damage to vehicles and phones. Villagers prevented the CJP team from visiting the school, citing local capabilities. They also opposed the CJP's views and campaign for school improvements. The incident occurred as the CJP continues its 'School Thik Karo' campaign.

title: Why India is betting $1.2 billion on homegrown construction equipment
content: India plans a $1.2 billion incentive scheme for advanced equipment manufacturing. This initiative aims to reduce reliance on China for critical machinery. The government expects fresh investment and domestic production growth over seven years. The scheme will cover tunnel boring machines and fire-fighting equipment. This move supports India's growing infrastructure development needs.

title: Violence & vandalism rock JU: Part of Nandalal Bose-designed emblem broken
content: Clashes erupted on the Jadavpur University campus involving political groups and university symbols. Supporters of ABVP damaged the university's emblem, which was designed by Nandalal Bose. Alleged outsiders later entered the campus, tearing flags and posters of Left organizations. They also attempted to erase graffiti related to social justice issues. The incidents highlight tensions and differing ideologies on the academic grounds.

title: IBM CEO Arvind Krishna on letter that sent stock down 25%, ‘worst day’ in history
content: The CEO of IBM took the bold step of revealing a financial deficit to stakeholders, triggering a notable decline in stock prices. This transparency caused clients to halt infrastructure advancements in favor of buying data center hardware. Krishna noted that distractions from rising AI trends and supply limitations were crucial factors. He is convinced that promptly revealing issues enables a sharper focus on strategic remedies.

title: Meet Lianna Genovese, 19, whose simple gadget helps people paint again
content: Lianna Genovese, a Canadian student, has created an inspiring device called Guided Hands to assist children with cerebral palsy in expressing their creativity through painting. This innovative tool harnesses arm and shoulder movements, enabling young artists to engage with touch screens effectively. Originally composed of basic materials, Guided Hands has transformed into a recognized commercial assistive technology, earning accolades worldwide for its significant impact.

title: Five pet swans escaped in Maryland; descendants later neared 4,000
content: Five mute swans escaped from an estate in Maryland in 1962 and their descendants multiplied to nearly 4,000 in the Chesapeake Bay region within four decades. The invasive birds eat large amounts of underwater grasses and have also been linked to the displacement of native birds, raising concerns among wildlife managers about their growing impact on the Bay's ecosystem.

title: Zomato founder Deepinder Goyal gives an update on Temple device
content: Zomato founder Deepinder Goyal revealed the Temple wearable device is now smaller and more powerful.  Pre-orders for the limited launch edition will begin very soon.  The device is expected to ship before the end of 2026.  PV Sindhu was recently seen wearing the Temple device at a championship.  This device tracks blood flow and oxygenation inside the brain.

title: Watch: Bathinda villagers peel off newly laid road with bare hands
content: Residents of Kotbhara and Ramgarh Bhundar villages allege poor road construction quality. Portions of the newly laid road are reportedly peeling off and breaking apart. Villagers demonstrated the poor quality by peeling off sections with their hands. They have informed authorities and demanded an investigation into the roadwork. Officials stated they will investigate the allegations and take appropriate action.

title: World’s most powerful: Railways eyes 35 hydrogen trains; looks at cheaper green fuel
content: India currently has the world's most powerful hydrogen train in operation and has also established a dedicated facility for manufacturing and supplying hydrogen for the train. The initial target is to deploy 35 hydrogen-powered trains on heritage routes.

title: Inside India nets: Intent, big sixes and footwork, Gill's plan against spin
content: Shubman Gill's aggressive approach against spin was on full display in India's first net session in Colombo, with the captain repeatedly using his feet and clearing the ropes against Ravindra Jadeja, Manav Suthar and Saransh Jain. With Kuldeep Yadav's place under discussion, India's spin combination is another key selection call ahead of the second Test.

title: Delhi government orders construction ban for 42 days to tackle winter air pollution
content: Delhi will ban all construction activities from December 10 to January 20. This measure aims to control the city's severe winter air pollution levels. AI-enabled cameras and a Dust Portal will monitor construction sites for violations. The government will issue warnings and fines for non-compliance with the new rules. Citizens are encouraged to report any observed construction work during this period.

title: 'Pass on the weed': Ex-India cricketer mocks de Villiers over Kohli-Sachin take

While de Villiers lauded Kohli's performance in overseas Test matches, Tendulkar's statistics suggest a more impressive overall record outside India. Kohli's successes as a captain and during his prime also contribute to the ongoing debate regarding their Test legacies and who truly holds the edge.

The accused faces charges including rape and criminal intimidation.

The South Korean military enhanced its monitoring efforts and shared intelligence with its allies. Meanwhile, North Korea dismissed diplomatic outreach from the US President as unworthy of a response. Such missile tests violate United Nations Security Council resolutions.

Police registered a case under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita for causing death by negligence.

title: US scientists are building a $12m 'digital brain' for drones inspired by insects
content: At Penn State, a research team is pioneering advanced drone decision-making systems modeled after insect neural mechanisms. Utilizing analogue computing alongside graphene materials, this initiative focuses on onboard data processing that replicates the natural filtering and coincidence detection seen in biology. With annual demonstrations of evolving prototypes, the goal is to enable fully autonomous drone swarms independent of external support.

This trend is driven by pharmaceutical advancements and growing patient bases.

Additionally, domestic equities began trading on a slightly weaker note.

Additionally, shadow fleets attempting to mask their locations complicate monitoring efforts, leading to potential volatility in oil prices and supply predictions.

title: Stock Market LIVE Updates, Sensex Today: Sensex, Nifty Trade Flat Amid Mixed Global Cues
content: Stock Market, Sensex, Share Market, Nifty LIVE Updates: Crude oil prices surge to near one-month high as US prepares sweeping sanctions on Iran.

title: US Teen Drops Social Media Addiction Lawsuit Against Meta, Google Before Trial
content: The plaintiff, a 15-year-old girl from New Jersey identified in California court records as PM-Y, had alleged the platforms' owners -- Meta Platforms, Google, and Snap Inc -- contributed to her social media addiction, depression, and self-harm.

title: Don't Issue New SIMs To Those Having 9 Connections: Centre Asks Telcos
content: The move will enable telecom operators to identify a subscriber who seeks to obtain mobile connections beyond the prescribed limit and prevent him from crossing such a limit.

title: Ex-Pak PM Imran Khan returns to jail after medical examination at Islamabad hospital
content: 73-year-old cricket legend has been facing health issues after 3 years in prison . he was taken to hospital days after the Supreme Court ordered a medical examination . his family and friends had sought permission for him to remain in hospital .

title: Watch: Indian seafarers take cover as vessel attacked in Hormuz back in April
content: the FSUI released an old video showing a vessel carrying 22 crew members, including 21 Indians, coming under attack in the Strait of Hormuz on April 22 . the footage shows several small boats surrounding the vessel, an RPG being fired and seafarers rushing to the ship’s alleyways to take cover .

title: 'Over 600 beadbis in 10 yrs': Harsimrat targets AAP, Cong over sacrilege cases
content: 'over 600 beadbis' took place in a decade, says sAD leader . 'we are very sorry for it,' she says . "we have vowed that until we punish the perpetrators, we will not rest," she apologises .

title: 'Freeze seats for 25 years': Congress backs Vijay-led TN govt's delimitation stand
content: former union minister and senior Congress leader said the party wants the existing allocation of Lok Sabha seats to be maintained for another 25 years . there should be no change to the current strength of 543 seats or Tamil Nadu’s 39 constituencies .

title: Revanth Reddy denied permission for US visit by Centre: Telangana CMO
content: the central govt has denied permission to CM Revanth's tour of the united kingdom . he will cut short his visit and return to the city on august 23 . the state government had sought central permission for the trip to the UK and USA .

title: 13-year-old Aniket Sarkar built a low-cost system to capture water from dry air
content: 13-year-old aniket Sarkar wanted to explore how moisture could be collected without depending entirely on traditional water sources . the project was developed with farmers in dry regions of the american Midwest and west in mind . it is an early-stage invention rather than a finished agricultural technology, but the project has already given the young inventor a clear direction .

title: 'Waiting for astrologer to fix date?' Udhayanidhi asks Vijay to act on corruption claims
content: udhayanidhi questioned the delay in making the findings public . he said the government did not have sufficient evidence to support its allegations . the chief minister urged him to open the files immediately and take action if there was evidence of wrongdoing .

title: 'Will not move till FIR is lodged': Rahul, Priyanka stage dharna over pellet gun use
content: Priyanka Gandhi joined Rahul Gandhi staging a 'dharna' at the Sansad Marg police station . he sought registration of a complaint over police action and excessive use of force against student protesters .

title: 8 on board killed as twin-engine charter plane crashes in remote Alaska
content: the twin-engine cessna charter plane crashed near a remote radar site in western Alaska . the aircraft was flying from Anchorage to Cape Newenham when it went down . it was carrying two pilots and six passengers .
